notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis; business-type funds accrual basis (as FY2023-FY2025). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); fund balance roll-forward 824,683 + 508,446 - 358,031 + transfers in 55,000 = 1,030,098. No cash roll-forward printed: ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 970,363 (p4), certificates of deposit 33,288 in ending_investments, county treasurer cash 26,447 a separate line (as FY2023); beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position Total column (p9): receipts = operating 381,404 + interest 5,680 + grant income 56,017 = 443,101 (no single printed total); disbursements = operating 226,700 + interest expense 3,852 = 230,552 (printed as total business-type expenses on the Statement of Activities p2). Beginning net position 3,437,819 is as restated (p3: as previously reported 1,793,062 + restatement 1,644,757). 3,437,819 + 443,101 - 230,552 - 112,604 = 3,537,764. The 57,604 Transfer to Community Care Center (Nursing Home Fund) goes outside the primary government; the other 55,000 matches the General Fund transfers in. Proprietary cash flows Total column (p11). Balance sheet: government-wide governmental column (p1) totals equal the governmental funds balance sheet (1,030,098; no capital assets), so governmental lines come from the funds balance sheet (p4, fund balance by classification); business-type lines and totals from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Statement capital outlay 18,536 mixes Administrative and Fire, so labelled plain Capital Outlay. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp14-15), more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule (p12, not recorded); Street Fund from its budget schedule (p13). Keno fund and enterprise funds have no schedules, so no detail for them (as FY2023). Intergovernmental kept as other state aid and grants as generic grants (no grantor printed).
